claim: Brighton Fringe supported Ben Carter’s mental health and acted with transparency.
reality: Brighton Fringe’s Managing Director, Amy Keogh, sent an unauthorised, defamatory disclosure about Ben Carter’s mental health and suicide attempt to his GP, falsely alleging paranoia, delusions, and fixation. The disclosure was made without legal authority or consent, and framed Brighton Fringe’s power grab over Ben’s venues as a safeguarding act. This occurred behind Ben’s back and constituted misuse of power, breach of confidentiality, and an attempt to erode his credibility in healthcare settings.
